  • Bachelor of Arts – Comprehensive Major in Family and Consumer Sciences

Bachelor of Arts – Comprehensive Major in Family and Consumer Sciences

A student must complete the Essential Studies requirements, the following core requirements, and one of the options listed below. Consultation with an advisor is recommended to help plan the sequencing of classes.

FCS Core Requirements

Course List
Code Title Credits
Essential Studies
Core Requirements
FCS 122PERSPECTIVES IN FAMILY AND CONSUMER SCIENCES3
FCS 139HUMAN DEVELOPMENT3
FCS 236FOOD & MEALS ACROSS THE LIFESPAN2
FCS 236LFOODS & MEALS ACROSS THE LIFESPAN LAB1
FCS 239PARTNERS IN EDUCATION3
FCS 247NUTRITION3
FCS 320AGING AND DEATH3
FCS 331RESOURCE MANAGEMENT3
FCS 337GUIDANCE TECHNIQUES IN HUMAN RELATIONS3
FCS 338PRENATAL AND INFANT PRACTICUM3
FCS 422PROFESSIONAL CAREER DEVELOPMENT3
FCS 435CONSUMER SCIENCE3

Family Studies

Course List
Code Title Credits
Core Requirements33

CA 440GENDER AND COMMUNICATION 3
CTE 434PRINCIPLES AND PHILOSOPHY OF CAREER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION3

Recommended elective options: HPEHP 332 SAFETY AND FIRST AID, HPEHP 429 MOTOR MOVEMENT, SPED 331 BEHAVIOR MODIFICATION AND MANAGEMENT, SPED 334 DIFFERENTIATED INSTRUCTION FOR DIVERSE CLASSROOMS, PSYC 231 EDUCATIONAL PSYCHOLOGY.
